"import cadquery as cq

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Regular polygon (8 sides) sketch on the "YZ" plane.
# Local sketch coordinates (u, v) in millimetres:
#   local u -> global +Y
#   local v -> global +Z
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Authoritative local vertex coordinates (regular octagon, exact numeric values)
points_local = [
    (3.520908, -10.571057),
    (15.692446, 3.186364),
    (14.571057, 21.520908),
    (0.813636, 33.692446),
    (-17.520908, 32.571057),
    (-29.692446, 18.813636),
    (-28.571057, 0.479092),
    (-14.813636, -11.692446),
]

# Named plane "YZ": maps local (u, v) -> global (0, u, v)
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Convert local sketch coordinates to world coordinates
pts_world = [P.toWorldCoords((u, v)) for (u, v) in points_local]

# Build exactly 8 line edges forming one closed profile
edges = []
n = len(pts_world)
for i in range(n):
    p1 = pts_world[i]
    p2 = pts_world[(i + 1) % n]  # wraps last vertex back to the first
    edges.append(cq.Edge.makeLine(p1, p2))

# Verify completion requirements: exactly 8 curve entities, closed loop
assert len(edges) == 8, "Expected exactly 8 curve entities"
for i in range(n):
    e_cur = edges[i]
    e_next = edges[(i + 1) % n]
    assert e_cur.Vertexes[-1].Center().toTuple() == e_next.Vertexes[0].Center().toTuple(), \
        "Edges must connect end-to-start forming a closed loop"

# Export the curves as a compound of edges to sketch.step
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
